name: honeycomb-hero
title: Honeycomb Hero
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A travel hero on a dark ground that shifts colour: a light line over a huge word in the theme's primary, and a honeycomb of hexagonal photographs with a primary hexagonal call to action set among them. The large hexagon is the slide on screen; its photograph fills the background, tinted with that photograph's own tone, so the whole section changes colour as, every four seconds or on the arrows at the foot, every hexagon moves one step along the ring, endlessly.
docs: Named export: HoneycombHero. Pass `title` and `titleAccent` (its letters that cross the photographs take `titleOverlapColor`, a light tint of the slide's tone by default), `subtitle`, `primaryActionLabel` (a \n breaks the line) and `primaryActionHref`, `images` ({ src, alt, tone? }[] in queue order — nine cells are visible; tone is the deep colour behind everything while that photograph is featured), `socialLinks`, `interval` in ms (0 turns autoplay off) and `onChange`. The section is always dark and reads the theme's dark tokens: the word, rule, arrows and call to action are primary (label primary-foreground); `accent` sets --primary for the section, `background` is the tone for photographs without one (a deep shade of the primary by default); `linkComponent` takes next/link.
